lines.en: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
lines.cn: 火灾过后，村庄们面临着哪些危险？

lines.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
lines.cn: 消防员们与这场森林火灾抗争了近三周，才终于将其控制住。

lines.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
lines.cn: 就在不久之前，这片乡村的周围几英里范围内，都长满了高大的树木。

lines.en: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
lines.cn: 此刻，烟雾仍从那片荒凉山丘上温暖的地面中升起。

lines.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction,
lines.cn: 冬天即将来临，那些山丘似乎随时都有可能摧毁周围的村庄。

lines.en: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
lines.cn: 因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引发严重的洪水。

lines.en: When the fire had at last been put out,
the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
lines.cn: 森林管理部门订购了几吨一种特殊的草籽，这种草籽生长速度非常快。

lines.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
lines.cn: 这些种子被飞机大量喷洒到地面上。

lines.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
lines.cn: 这些飞机已经在进行播种作业近一个月了，就在这时，雨开始下了。

lines.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
lines.cn: 然而，到那时为止，草已经在许多地方生根发芽了。

lines.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
lines.cn: 取而代之的是那些已经在那里生长了几个世纪的参天大树。

lines.en: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
lines.cn: 在烧焦的土壤中，开始出现了一小块块绿色的斑点。
